LanguageData.RimMult.SteamRequired: RimMult needs Steam: start RimWorld through Steam to play multiplayer.
LanguageData.RimMult.PortInUse: Could not open UDP port {0}. Is another server already using it?
LanguageData.RimMult.CannotJoinSelf: You can't join your own game.
LanguageData.RimMult.BadAddress: Enter an address like 203.0.113.5 or myserver.net:26480.
LanguageData.RimMult.NoFriendsHosting: None of your friends is hosting right now.
LanguageData.RimMult.JoinHint: You can also join a friend from the Steam friends list: right-click them → "Join game".
LanguageData.RimMult.OpenPort: Also allow joining by address (UDP port)
LanguageData.RimMult.OpenPortTip: Steam friends can always join without this. Enable it for players joining by IP address; the port must be forwarded on your router.
LanguageData.RimMult.HostHint: Your Steam friends will see your game in their list. Everyone needs the same mods in the same order.
LanguageData.RimMult.HostingInfo: Friends can join from the Steam friends list.
LanguageData.RimMult.HostingInfoPort: Friends can join from the Steam friends list, others by address on UDP port {0}.
LanguageData.RimMult.WrongPasswordHint: Enter the server password on the left and press "Try again".
LanguageData.RimMult.ModExtra: Not on the server: {0} ({1}) — disable it
LanguageData.RimMult.ModOrder: Same mods, but in a different load order. Match the host's order.
LanguageData.RimMult.ModSettingsDiffer: Your mod list differs from the server's.
LanguageData.RimMult.ModListHashHint: Put this into "ModListHash" in a dedicated server's server.json to pin the required mod list.
LanguageData.RimMult.WorldNone: The shared world has not been created yet. The first player to create a colony picks the planet.
LanguageData.RimMult.InWorld: You are playing in the shared world. Time is synchronized with everyone.
LanguageData.RimMult.OtherSave: The loaded save is not from this server's world. Return to the main menu to create or load a colony of this world.
LanguageData.RimMult.CanShareWorld: The server has no world yet. You can make the planet of the loaded game the shared world.
LanguageData.RimMult.WorldLocked: Multiplayer: the planet is set by the shared world and can't be changed.
LanguageData.RimMult.TileNearPlayer: Too close to another player's colony.
LanguageData.RimMult.WorldCreating: Sending your planet to the server…
LanguageData.RimMult.WaitingForHostWorld: Waiting for the host to create the world (start or load their colony).
LanguageData.RimMult.SameWorldSave: This save is on the same planet as the shared world. Attach it to play it in multiplayer.
LanguageData.RimMult.LoadAndHost: Load a save and host it
LanguageData.RimMult.ClientOnlyHint: Checked mods are not compared with other players: use it for purely visual or interface mods (map previews, camera, HUD). Mods that add content (items, animals, factions, biomes) must stay unchecked and match.
LanguageData.RimMult.ClientOnlyDiffHint: If a mod above only changes visuals or the interface, mark it as client-side in the RimMult mod settings instead.
LanguageData.RimMult.ErrorHostNoResponse: The host did not respond. They may still be loading; press "Try again".
LanguageData.RimMult.ErrorSteamConnect: Steam lost the connection to the host.
LanguageData.RimMult.KickProtocolMismatch: different RimMult versions. Both players need the latest build.
LanguageData.RimMult.KickModListMismatch: your mods differ from the host's (see below).
LanguageData.RimMult.KickAlreadyConnected: you connected again from another place.
LanguageData.RimMult.KickBanned: you are banned from this server.

LanguageData.RimMult.ParcelReturnedText: The colony you sent a parcel to no longer exists, so it came back:\n\n{0}
LanguageData.RimMult.ParcelBrokenText: A parcel from {0} could not be unpacked (probably different mods). Details are in the log.
LanguageData.RimMult.PawnNotColonist: {0} is not a colonist or colony animal
LanguageData.RimMult.PawnMechanoid: {0}: mechanoids can't move to another colony yet
LanguageData.RimMult.PawnTitled: {0} holds a royal title and can't leave the empire's reach
LanguageData.RimMult.TradeOfferDesc: Exchange goods with {0}. Both of you choose what to give; when both accept, the goods arrive by drop pod.
LanguageData.RimMult.TradeOwnerAway: {0} is not playing in the world right now
LanguageData.RimMult.TradeNotInWorld: you are not playing in the shared world
LanguageData.RimMult.TradeBusy: You are already trading with someone.
LanguageData.RimMult.TradeWaitingJoin: Waiting for {0} to open the trade…
LanguageData.RimMult.TradeHint: Choose what you give on the left. When you both accept, the goods are sent.
LanguageData.RimMult.TradeTheyAccepted: {0} accepted your offer. Accept theirs to complete the trade.
LanguageData.RimMult.TradeDone: Trade complete. The goods are on their way by drop pod.
LanguageData.RimMult.TradeNoGoods: Nothing in your stockpiles to offer.
LanguageData.RimMult.CaravanTradeAway: {0} is not playing in the world right now. Wait here and choose "Trade" again later, or hand over the cargo.
LanguageData.RimMult.TradeInviteCaravan: {0}'s caravan has arrived at your colony and wants to trade.
LanguageData.RimMult.TradeHintCaravan: On the left is what {0} carries. What you buy is loaded into the caravan.
LanguageData.RimMult.TradeHintPartnerCaravan: {0} trades from a caravan at your colony: what they buy goes into their caravan, what they give lands here.
LanguageData.RimMult.ParcelToCaravanText: {0} took on the goods bought from {1}:\n\n{2}
LanguageData.RimMult.ModeSeparateDesc: Everyone founds their own colony on one shared planet. Each computer simulates only its own colony, so a weak PC doesn't slow down the others. Visit each other with caravans, send pods, trade.
LanguageData.RimMult.ModeCoopDesc: Everyone plays the host's colony together. The host's game runs the simulation, friends see it live and give orders: designate, build, draft, right-click orders, work priorities, research. The host's computer does all the work. Experimental: actions show up with a delay and the host may lag.
LanguageData.RimMult.ModeCoopHostInfo: Co-op: friends join your colony from their lobby.
LanguageData.RimMult.CoopJoinHint: The host's game will be loaded here (your current game is closed without saving).
LanguageData.RimMult.CoopPlaying: You are in the host's colony.
LanguageData.RimMult.CoopGuestJoining: {0} is joining your colony. The game is paused while they load.
LanguageData.RimMult.CoopHostNotReady: The host isn't in a game yet. Try again once they have loaded their colony.
LanguageData.RimMult.CoopLoadFailed: The host's game could not be loaded. Check the log (mods must match).
LanguageData.RimMult.CoopDisconnected: Connection to the host lost: {0}\n\nThis is now just a copy of the host's colony.
LanguageData.RimMult.CoopNewMap: The host opened a new map: loading the game again so you have it too.
LanguageData.RimMult.CoopNoSave: In co-op only the host saves the game.
LanguageData.RimMult.AllowPvpTip: Players can declare war on each other and raid each other's colonies with caravans and drop pods.
LanguageData.RimMult.DiplomacyDesc: Declare war on {0}, offer peace or an alliance.
LanguageData.RimMult.DeclareWarConfirm: Declare war on {0}? You will be able to raid each other's colonies. Peace needs both of you to agree.
LanguageData.RimMult.WarOnYouText: {0} has declared war on you. Expect raids by caravan or drop pods. You can offer peace through "Diplomacy" on their colony.
LanguageData.RimMult.DiplomacyPeaceMadeText: You made peace with {0}. No more raids between you.
LanguageData.RimMult.DiplomacyAllianceBrokenText: The alliance with {0} has been broken. You are neutral again.
LanguageData.RimMult.RaidPvpOff: PvP is off on this server
LanguageData.RimMult.RaidNotAtWar: you are not at war with {0}
LanguageData.RimMult.RaidLaunched: Your war party attacks {0}! You will hear how it went when it's over.
LanguageData.RimMult.RaidArrivedText: {0} is attacking your colony with {1} fighters: {2}.\n\nThey are another player's colonists: whoever escapes alive goes back to {0}, with whatever they stole and whoever they carry off.
LanguageData.RimMult.RaidOverText: The raid by {0} is over.\n\nKilled: {1}. Left behind (wounded or captured): {2}. Escaped: {3}.
LanguageData.RimMult.RaidReturnText:
Your raid on {0} is over.

Coming back: {1}.
Killed: {2}.
Left behind (wounded or captured): {3}.
LanguageData.RimMult.HelpArrivedText: Your ally {0} sent help: {1}.\n\nThey are your colonists for now, but {0} commands them in person, from your game. When {0} goes home, they leave too.
LanguageData.RimMult.HelpJoining: {0} comes to help in person: the world is paused while their game loads.
LanguageData.RimMult.HelpStartedText: This is your ally's colony. Command your people as usual: draft, right-click orders, Shift, attack target, abilities. Your ally commands theirs.\n\n"Go home" loads your colony again and your people come back by pod.
LanguageData.RimMult.HelpGoHomeDesc: Load your colony. Your people come back home by pod.
LanguageData.RimMult.HelpGoHomeConfirm: Go home together with your people?
LanguageData.RimMult.VisitNotYours: Not one of yours: you can only command your own people.
LanguageData.RimMult.SyncModComponents: Co-op: stream mods' data to guests
LanguageData.RimMult.SyncModComponentsHint: Every 2 seconds the host sends guests mods' data that changed (their game, world and map components), so pipe networks, toggles and the like don't lag behind for guests. Turn off if a mod causes errors for guests.
LanguageData.RimMult.CoopReloadHint: If something looks different from the host's game: the host's game loads again (everyone is paused meanwhile).
LanguageData.RimMult.ReportHint: Saves versions, the mod list and the log's errors to a file: send it to the developer with a description.
LanguageData.RimMult.OtherMultiplayerMod: The "Multiplayer" mod (rwmt.Multiplayer) is active. It changes the same parts of the game as RimMult (ticks, orders, saving) and the two don't work together. Disable one of them.
LanguageData.RimMult.RaidBouncedText: The attack could not take place (peace was made, or the enemy left the game). Your people are back home: {0}.
LanguageData.RimMult.RaidPodsLive: Drop pod assault on {0}, led in person
LanguageData.RimMult.RaidArrivedLive: {0} leads this raid in person, commanding their fighters from your game.
LanguageData.RimMult.VisitGoing: Your colony is saved. Loading {0}'s colony: you will lead the raid in person.
LanguageData.RimMult.VisitRefused: {0} won't let you in (the raid hasn't arrived or is already over)
LanguageData.RimMult.VisitJoining: {0} joins the fight in person: the world is paused while their game loads.
LanguageData.RimMult.VisitLeft: {0} left the fight: their raid is AI-led again.
LanguageData.RimMult.VisitStartedText:
This is the enemy's colony. Command your fighters as usual: draft, right-click orders, Shift, attack target, abilities.

Your fighters' buttons: "Retreat" (leave over the map edge with the loot), "Kidnap" (carry off a downed enemy), "Steal" (carry off an item), "Go home".

When the fight is over your colony loads again and the survivors come back as a caravan.
LanguageData.RimMult.VisitOver: The raid is over: going home.
LanguageData.RimMult.VisitInterrupted: The fight was interrupted: {0}. Going home.
LanguageData.RimMult.VisitBackHome: You are home again. The raid's results come by letter.
LanguageData.RimMult.VisitRetreatDesc: Leave over the nearest map edge, with whatever is carried. Those who leave go home.
LanguageData.RimMult.VisitKidnapDesc: Carry a downed enemy off the map: they become your prisoner.
LanguageData.RimMult.VisitStealDesc: Carry an item off the map.
LanguageData.RimMult.VisitGoHomeDesc: Load your colony. Your fighters stay here, AI-led.
LanguageData.RimMult.VisitGoHomeConfirm: Go home? The raid goes on without you, AI-led.
LanguageData.RimMult.VisitNoDesignate: In another player's colony you can only command your fighters.
LanguageData.RimMult.ShowCursors: Co-op: show other players' cursors and selection
LanguageData.RimMult.ShowCursorsHint: See where the other players point and what they have selected (in their color); they see your cursor too. Turn it off and yours isn't sent either.
LanguageData.RimMult.Chronicle.RaidLaunchedLive: {0} leads a raid on {1} in person: {5}.
LanguageData.RimMult.Chronicle.RaidEnded: {0}'s raid on {1} is over: {2} came back, {3} captives taken, {4} died.
LanguageData.RimMult.ModsFixAllTip: Subscribe to the missing mods on the Workshop, download the latest versions of the ones that differ (RimMult included), enable and disable as needed and put them in the host's order. Your client-side mods (translations, interface) stay. One game restart, and it joins the host by itself.
LanguageData.RimMult.ModsCannotFix:
Your mods and their order already match the host's; what still differs can't be fixed from here: {0}.
If these are Workshop mods, the host probably has a newer version than the Workshop (or the other way round): whoever is behind should restart the Steam client. Local mods have to be copied by hand.
LanguageData.RimMult.ModCheckTip: Compare your mods with this host's without joining — and make yours the same right away.
LanguageData.RimMult.ModCheckSame: Your mods match the host's — you can join.
LanguageData.RimMult.ModCheckDiffers: Your mods differ from the host's:
LanguageData.RimMult.ModCheckNoList: The host doesn't know its mod list yet (nobody is in its game) — just join.
LanguageData.RimMult.ModCheckProtocol: Different RimMult versions (protocol: yours {0}, the host's {1}) — make yours like the host's:
LanguageData.RimMult.ModCheckFailed: Couldn't get the host's mods: {0} (the host may have an old RimMult).
LanguageData.RimMult.ModSyncHint: Steam is downloading the host's mods. As soon as everything is ready, the game saves the mod list, restarts and joins the host.
LanguageData.RimMult.NpcLayoutApplied: NPC settlements now match the shared world: {0} placed, {1} removed.
